final_primary_decisions.scurrius-optimal: THIRD OPTION: Scythe for boss damage, bone mace for instant summoned-rat attacks. Keeping bone mace in Recommended preserves practical progression. A cost/XP-focused account can camp bone mace; do not pretend its boss-only DPS exceeds Scythe.
final_primary_decisions.mole-optimal: CONDITIONAL: Fang for sustained melee farming, supported by current KPH guidance and consistent damage. Scythe has a slight stationary advantage in the reproduced kit but digging/travel/cost can erase it; no numeric KPH is invented. Dharok is a full-set, low-HP alternative, not a universal upgrade.
final_primary_decisions.sarachnis-optimal: THIRD OPTION: charged Obligator on Thrust with full Inquisitor; stationary evidence exceeds the tested Scythe kits. Aranea boots retain web utility rather than maximizing an irrelevant stationary boot bonus. Scythe remains the owned-weapon substitute.
final_primary_decisions.amox-optimal: THIRD OPTION: charged Obligator on Thrust replaces mace as the current high-end branch. Full Inquisitor, negative armour and target size are explicit. Blood Moon remains Recommended; Scythe is a valid alternate for ice overlap/ownership. The old mace setup is not called optimal merely because it was Q07.
final_primary_decisions.kbd-optimal: THIRD OPTION: maximize the stated shielded crossbow branch with actual charged ward and usable ring ID. This is an owned-high-end setup, not a required KBD grind; the lower-risk rune-crossbow branch remains Recommended. No claim this beats every shieldless strategy.
final_primary_decisions.vork-optimal: Q07 WINS on primary DHCB/Salve/ward equipment; add a coherent high-HP ruby-spec ZCB switch and exact pouch state. Charged shield state is separate from its item ID.
final_primary_decisions.huey-optimal: THIRD OPTION: lance on crush for 1x1 body; charged Obligator on Thrust for head; full Blood Moon plus dual macuahuitl for tail. The reproduced phase comparisons support different winners. Do not label a single weapon best across the whole encounter.
final_primary_decisions.gg-optimal: Q07 WINS on Scythe/Slayer-helmet core, with corrected high-end strength/tribrid accessories and a mandatory rock hammer. Preserve atlatl ranged method; Granite hammer is strong once owned but first-kill Entry uses an independent weapon.
final_primary_decisions.barrows-optimal: THIRD OPTION: fast powered-staff high-end branch, selected using full-kit finite-HP comparisons, with a real Ahrim ranged switch. Midgame Wind Wave/Twinflame is retained; do not confuse a max-level powered-staff comparison with 65-75 Magic progression.
final_primary_decisions.rex-recommended: Q07 WINS on complete Guthan healing switch; remove a default 93-Slayer occult acquisition assumption. Trident swamp is an owned upgrade; seas/Iban/Earth Wave alternatives are explicit.
final_primary_decisions.rex-optimal: CONDITIONAL: Sanguinesti plus high ranged defence is selected for sustained single-Rex safespot trips, where healing and the respawn bottleneck matter. Eye/earth spells are speed/ownership alternatives; do not sell this as universal tribrid BIS.
final_primary_decisions.zulrah-recommended: INDEPENDENT WINS on Twinflame fire-spell direction. Default to achievable accessories rather than requiring occult/zenyte crafting for the midgame branch; add them when owned. Exact air/blood runes and blue-phase caveat are mandatory.
final_primary_decisions.zulrah-optimal: CONDITIONAL: Shadow with a coherent high-magic-damage kit for the fixed magic-only method; respect damage cap and blue-form resistance. Twinflame/trident are conditional lower-cost/utility branches, not declared inferior at every Magic level.
final_primary_decisions.supreme-optimal: CONDITIONAL: large-target Scythe with controlled single-king access. Whip remains practical Recommended; do not force a Fang upgrade on this low-melee-defence target. This is not a tank-all-kings solo preset.
